Name: Pets' Quality of Life
Author: Minakie
Description:
[i][left][s][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zXgDX0nc/about-the-mod.png[/img]﻿[/s][/left][/i]
[b][u][left]This mod is still compatible with the 1.5 update![/left][/u][/b]
[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/coolwyngs.627316/]Coolwyngs[/url][size=3] asked me to share my water/food bowl and I decided to take the chance to make this mod.[/size]

[size=3]This mod turns the farm pet's water bowl and Dusty's water bow into a water/food bowl so that they don't starve to death. It also gives Dusty a proper dog house instead of an old cardboard box, a rubber ball to play with and a fancier Dog sign.

"[i]This mod is still relevant to 1.4, the event that improves Dusty's pen doesn't even trigger till year 3. Until then this can give the pup food and water.[/i]" ~[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/65233136]HannaVictoria[/url]
[/size]

[center][size=3][/size][/center][center][size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/932/932-1576437043-574760047.png[/img]
[/size][size=3]

You can choose between a yellow or a red dog house.
You can add optional seasonal add-ons (flower, fruit, leaf).


[/size]﻿[size=3][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/932/932-1576437065-1918456314.png[/img][/size][/center][size=3][center][/center]

Each of the 4 elements of this mod (farm bowl, Dusty bowl, Dusty house, dog sign) can be turned on/off at will in the config file, to prevent incompatibility issues with other mods that may change the same elements.


[u][b][u][img]https://i.postimg.cc/d0qJ6Fgb/installation.png[/img]﻿[/u][/b]
[/u]
[size=3]- Make sure you have [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][size=3] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][size=3] installed as well[/size]
[size=3]- Download my latest file and unzip it[/size]
[size=3]- Navigate to your "[/size][i]Stardew Valley\Mods"[/i][size=3] folder and drop the extracted folder there[/size]
[size=3]- Run the game to generate the config file (just leave it as-is or tweak the options to your liking)
- Have fun :)[/size][/size]

Downloads.Description: Changes the pet bowl on the Farm, in an attempt to make it compatible with map-recolors.

Manifest.Name: Minakie's Pets' Quality of Life
Manifest.Description: This mod slightly improves the lives of the farm pets and Dusty by giving them food alongside their water. It also gives Dusty a rubber ball to play with.
Manifest.Author: Minakie
